# Debt Free — محرر الديون

> A private, offline-first web app (PWA) that tells you the exact month you will be debt-free and compares the Snowball and Avalanche payoff strategies. Arabic-first (RTL) with English, built for Kuwait and the GCC by X Star Software.

- No accounts, no servers, no tracking: all data stays in the browser (IndexedDB) and can be exported as a JSON backup.
- Strategies: Snowball (smallest balance first) and Avalanche (highest rate first), with freed payments rolling over to the next debt.
- Features: extra monthly payment and one-time payment what-ifs, per-debt payoff dates, payment history with undo, monthly schedule, debt-to-income ratio, Islamic-finance terminology (profit instead of interest), printable plan, calendar reminder and a shareable progress card that contains no amounts.
- Figures are planning estimates; lenders may calculate differently (daily interest, fees, early-settlement terms).

App: https://debt-free-tracker-phi.vercel.app/
